thought.text: Port 6042 refused plain HTTP (expected — it's a WebSocket-only server). Let me confirm it's actually listening and check the worker process.

reasoning_content:
Everything works. The websocket port 6042 responds with HTTP 000 because it's a websocket server that doesn't respond to plain HTTP GET (it upgrades). Let me verify the websocket server is actually listening via ss/proc. Earlier ss had an error (exit 127) - ss may not be installed. Let me check with /proc/net/tcp or lsof.

Let me verify the websocket listening and the worker. Also the guide says `bin/dev` should work. Let me check the manual-setup guide expectations briefly and verify port 6042 is bound.

action.command: cd /workspace && echo "---LISTEN---"; cat /proc/net/tcp | awk 'NR>1{print $2}' | sed 's/.*://' | while read h; do echo $((16#$h)); done | sort -n | uniq | grep -E "^(3000|6042|9200|6379|5432)$"; echo "---PROC CMDLINES---"; for pid in $(pgrep -f "websocket-server|background-worker|dartsass"); do echo "PID $pid: $(tr '\0' ' ' < /proc/$pid/cmdline | head -c 150)"; done; echo "---bin/dev---"; head -30 bin/dev 2>/dev/null; echo "---GEMFILE foreman/forego---"; grep -iE "foreman|forego" Gemfile
